titulo_es: Invite, accept and reject with courtesy

Vill du fika med oss.en: You want to have a coffee with us?

texto: Invite, accept or reject with courtesy and propose another moment. **Vill du fika med oss?** means «You want to have a coffee with us?». Read the expression as a unit, identify the main word and use it in a daily situation. If your device has a Swedish voice, listen to the example and repeat it. Sequence 1 of 3: incorporates this expression and reviews the above.
